congestion.decision: Investigate SRAM pin escape and surrounding communication geometry before another broad repair cycle. Keep the current storage/fetch contract and validated checkpoint as control.
evidence_limits: Saved-grid overflow differs from the flow report by four units on the prior route and one on the current route; keep both counters and do not silently substitute them.
Hotspot membership uses GCell centers and macro bounding boxes, not an exact detailed-track obstruction test.
Guide/body overlap is a spatial screen, not a DRC violation or proof of why a route is congested.
The failed incremental repair is a tool failure, not evidence that this microarchitecture cannot fit.

probe.error: GRT-0183: Net net6399: heap underflow during 3D maze routing
probe.outcome: No candidate accepted. Stop the one-probe study; do not launch independent routing, pin simulation, or a second repair cycle.
probe.boundary: Failure occurred inside the repair command while its global-route estimator was updating. This does not establish the tool root cause, physical impossibility, or the effect of the unsaved partial edit.

next_investigation.objective: Explain and reduce communication pressure at the actual SRAM pin boundaries while preserving the current storage/fetch execution contract.
read_only_first: Bind pin geometries, macro obstructions, power routes and saved capacity on each routing layer to the same checkpoint.
Separate upload broadcast, address delivery, SRAM returns and unrelated transit near the macros; include complete incident connections of any proposed cell group.
Measure which legal escape paths and driver/consumer locations reduce demand through the crowded region, including their earliest/latest arrival obligations.
next_investigation.admission: One physical-organization candidate needs a measurable change in the targeted geometry or capacity and preserved pin access, plus a cost estimate of all incident wires. The previous address-only projection and unchanged-capacity screen remain rejected.
next_investigation.stop: No further generic repair loop or detailed-route launch from this study. A new storage/fetch organization requires separate schedule, area and whole-chip evidence.

boundary: Fresh measurements and saved GCell/guide geometry locate electrical load and routing pressure. The local probe failed inside OpenROAD before saving a candidate; no improved circuit, routing closure, extracted timing or backend promotion is claimed. Grid and flow overflow totals remain separately reported.
